title: Semilinear lift of the resolution cohomology map
statement: For the resolution data D and degree p, the additive map D.map p is the underlying function of a semilinear map over h.appTop.hom.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Section 01F7, Equation 01F9 and Remark 01FB; Derived Categories 013P, 013S, 05TG for resolution comparisons

proof.text: Construct the semilinear lift by checking scalar compatibility on sections, cycles, boundaries, homology and the resolution comparison maps.

proof_origin.place: Parent basic-properties proof, clause (1), made precise for arbitrary resolution data
